stories.title: G7 orders a 100m-barrel stock release, front-loaded with diesel
stories.summary: At a virtual meeting, G7 leaders agreed a coordinated release of 100 million barrels through the IEA over four months, with a substantial diesel release in the first 20 days. They said they would coordinate refinery maintenance, condemned Iran's attacks, and pledged to maintain sanctions on Russia.

causes.why: The loss of Russian diesel tightened the market
No Hormuz reopening in sight
Implements the March commitments

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula into Brazil's Oct 25 runoff
stories.summary: Brazil's electoral court reported Flávio Bolsonaro won 47.03% in the first round against President Lula's 45.16%. The two meet in a runoff on Oct 25.

causes.why: Rematch of the 2022 Lula–Bolsonaro contest
Part of the region's rightward swing

analysis.text: A Bolsonaro win on Oct 25 would put all of Latin America's three largest economies except Mexico under governments aligned with Trump.

stories.unplaced: A national election; no single site.

stories.title: Mecca pact invoked for the first time: Turkey and Pakistan to deploy to Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: After an emergency meeting in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan agreed to activate 'collective deterrence measures' and rapidly deploy agreed forces to the kingdom against Houthi attacks. The same day, Saudi-backed Yemeni forces said they had retaken Mokha. Al-Monitor reported Turkey's contribution was technical and defensive.

causes.why: Treaty invoked
The Houthi offensive and attacks on the kingdom

analysis.text: This is the first operational test of a Gulf security order without the US at its centre. The Conversation and Al-Monitor both expect support roles rather than combat against the Houthis.

stories.title: Moscow Format ends without a communiqué as Pakistan–Taliban rift persists
stories.summary: The Taliban said problems with Pakistan could be resolved through diplomacy. Dawn reported the Oct 5 Moscow Format consultations ended without a joint communiqué because Pakistan and the Taliban disagreed over language on terrorist networks. Islamabad says talks cannot be unconditional and demands a verifiable mechanism against TTP attacks. Earlier mediation by Qatar and Turkey, Saudi Arabia and China failed to produce a lasting settlement.

causes.why: Unresolved war

stories.unplaced: Consultations in Moscow; no place entity yet.

stories.title: RSF drone swarm hits El Obeid
stories.summary: Military sources said about 10 one-way attack drones struck El Obeid, the North Kordofan capital and base of the army's 5th Infantry Division, injuring at least six civilians. The state government blamed the RSF.

causes.why: The RSF threat to El Obeid continues

stories.title: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of an 'all-out invasion'; Eritrea cites a 'war of aggression'
stories.summary: In a letter to the UN Security Council, Ethiopia said Eritrean troops had advanced up to 60 km into Tigray. Eritrea denied backing the TPLF and accused Addis Ababa of seeking the port of Assab. The two had already cut diplomatic ties, and Ethiopia's army had retaken Mekelle from the TPLF.

causes.why: The TPLF war pulled in Eritrea

analysis.text: Abiy's demand for sea access turns a counter-insurgency into a possible interstate war over Assab.

stories.unplaced: Diplomatic exchange; the fighting was across Tigray.

stories.title: Houthi strike on Riyadh's airport kills 12, the worst attack on the kingdom in a decade
stories.summary: A strike on King Khalid International Airport killed 12 people and injured 309, according to Saudi civil aviation authorities. Victims included Saudis and foreign nationals, among them an American. Flights were suspended.

causes.why: Houthis escalated despite the pact
Houthi campaign against the kingdom

stories.title: US oil blockade pushes Cuba toward humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: Cuba's energy minister said private-sector imports allowed by the US cover less than 3% of fuel needs. Only one Russian tanker has reached the island since January, when Trump halted Venezuelan shipments and threatened tariffs on any country supplying Cuba. ICE said it seized 90 biodiesel shipments bound for Cuba on Oct 7. Blackouts and shortages of water and medicine are spreading.

causes.why: Loss of Venezuelan oil
Pressure campaign continued after the talks

analysis.text: Al Jazeera reports the administration has signalled it wants to topple Cuba's government. Collapse risk is rising, and with it the risk of a migration crisis.

stories.title: Hungary lifts its veto and the EU opens two more Ukraine accession clusters
stories.summary: After Ukraine adopted protections for minority-language education, including for Hungarians in Transcarpathia, Budapest dropped its veto and the EU opened Clusters 2 and 3, so four of six are now open. Magyar and Zelenskyy met in Brussels on Oct 16.

causes.why: The Magyar government reversed Orbán's blockade

stories.unplaced: A Council decision; no single site.

stories.title: Gaza's phase two stalls: no Hamas disarmament, no Israeli withdrawal
stories.summary: The Board of Peace envoy said Israel will withdraw from Gaza only after 'verified' Hamas disarmament. As of mid-October, neither disarmament nor withdrawal had begun. Long War Journal reported Israel blocked a Board of Peace base and the IDF logged 31 ceasefire violations on Oct 1–15.
stories.unplaced: Gaza has no place entity yet.

stories.title: Israel's 'Yellow Line' hardens an occupation zone in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Despite the June framework, Israel holds a zone up to 10 km deep in southern Lebanon. Behind the 'Yellow Line' it keeps demolishing homes; about 50 frontline villages are destroyed. Defence Minister Katz has said troops will not withdraw, and a 4 km 'Grey Line' buffer is under discussion.

causes.why: The Lebanon war
The US–Iran deal's 'all fronts' clause died with the MoU

stories.unplaced: A boundary line across southern Lebanon; no single site.
